content: ऐक्यम् .²1 Oneness, unity, harmony; तेषां द्वयोर्द्वयोरैक्यं बिभिदे न कदाचन <ls>R. 10. 82</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 33</ls>. .²2 Unanimity. .²3 Identity, sameness. .²4 Especially, the identity of the human soul or of the universe with the Deity. .²5 An aggregate, whole. .²6 (In <ab>alg.</ab>) The product of the length and depth of the portions or little excavations differing in depth (Colebrooke).
